etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Mia developed as a short form of Maria in several European naming traditions and later became an independent given name. Its spelling also coincides with Italian mia, meaning 'my' or 'mine' in feminine contexts. These connections explain the name, but do not establish the unidentified lowercase token as a Malay dictionary word.
